title: pericopsis laxiflora
intro: Pericopsis laxiflora, commonly known as Pala Pala or African Yellow Wood, is a tropical tree species native to tropical Africa. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial activities. The therapeutic actions of Pericopsis laxiflora include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties are believed to include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds.
